@gideon.sato Draft Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team, from #inc-vtg-hartford:

Incident: Gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant (Gideon's industrial account), 3 Aug 2026. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected; scheduling via the dispatch office was not. Carrowmere Cloud checked the Hartford gateway route. Ticket: INC-4821.

Timeline (Aug 3, 2026):
- 10:42 AM: first report, gate kiosks offline, both lanes down.
- 11:03 AM: kiosk 1 back online; trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- 11:07 AM: both lanes confirmed working.

Open item: status-page access for Mateo's account is still being investigated; the admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see arrivals.

I posted the draft in #strategic-random as its own message, and it's for you to review and forward.

It gives the first report at 10:42 AM on Aug 3, kiosk 1 back at 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in), and both lanes confirmed working at 11:07 AM, all from the #inc-vtg-hartford timeline. It also cites INC-4821 and notes the open status-page access issue for Mateo's account.

Nadia and Ruth can see the draft in this channel. It contains no finance figures.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.
